title: Simulador Oficial Completo TOEIC® - Versión 2
description: Simulador completo real de Listening & Reading enfocado en ApexCorp y el líder the Operations Chief.

parts.visual:
## 📝 Simulador Oficial TOEIC® (Versión 2)

Evaluación de **Listening & Reading** en tiempo real:

1. **Listening Section**: Evalúa tu comprensión en ApexCorp usando NexusCRM.
2. **Reading Section**: Mide tu análisis gramatical de memorandos emitidos por the Operations Chief.

*Inicia tu prueba simulada oficial.*
parts.audio: Welcome to the Full TOEIC Simulation. Manage your time efficiently across both listening and reading stages. Let's begin.

questions.question: [PART 1 - PHOTO]: Select the best description of ApexCorp's office photo.
questions.audio_script: A) They are loading packages onto the truck. B) They are signing the shipping invoices. C) The warehouse doors are closed. D) They are reviewing the freight shipping terms.
questions.explanation: La descripción correcta es la D, ya que se ve a los agentes de logística revisando las cláusulas del flete marítimo.

questions.question: [PART 3 - CONVERSATION]: Listen to the dialogue and answer: What does the man agree to do next?
questions.audio_script:
M: Hi Emily, did you get a chance to review the logistics invoice from ApexCorp?
W: Yes. The freight rates are reasonable, but the port clearance fee is higher than expected.
M: Let's call the Operations Chief to request a waiver.
options: Sign the contract as currently written.
Call the manager to negotiate an extension of the delivery window.
Write a new memorandum to sales staff.
questions.correct_answer: Call the manager to negotiate an extension of the delivery window.
questions.explanation: El hombre dice: 'I will call their manager to negotiate an extension'.

questions.question:
[PART 5]: Complete the business sentence correctly:

"All employees are strictly required to comply ___ the updated security rules in NexusCRM."
questions.explanation: El verbo 'comply' rige gramaticalmente la preposición 'with' (comply with / cumplir con).

questions.question:
[PART 7]: Read the memorandum and answer: **When will the migration to NexusCRM officially occur?**

**MEMORANDUM**

*To:* Logistics Partners
*From:* Operations Department
*Subject: Port Freight Clearance & NexusCRM Integration*

Please note that starting next Tuesday, all bills of lading must be logged through NexusCRM. Training is scheduled for this Friday at 9:00 AM in Conference Room A.
questions.explanation: El memorando dice: 'starting next Tuesday, we are officially retiring our legacy sales tool and migrating to NexusCRM'.
